title: Aft Cargo Compartment Sill Frames — Detailed Visual Inspection

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Scheduled detailed visual inspection of the aft cargo compartment sill frames and their lower flange run-outs between stations C52 and C66, with the acceptance limits and the reporting rule for any indication found.

sections.purpose: This task gives the detailed visual inspection of the aft cargo compartment sill frames, their lower flange run-outs and the loading rail reaction brackets, and the limits that decide whether an indication is acceptable.
sections.job_setup_note: The aircraft must be empty and on its wheels in the level attitude. The aft cargo compartment lining and the floor panels must be removed between stations C52 and C66 before the task starts. Lighting of at least 800 lux at the inspection surface is required and a 10x magnifier must be available. Two people are needed because the inspection surface is below waist height and the second person records.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE AFT CARGO DOOR IS SAFE AGAINST INADVERTENT CLOSING BEFORE YOU ENTER THE COMPARTMENT. 2. Remove the cargo floor panels between stations C52 and C66. 3. Remove the cargo lining panels on the left and the right side. 4. Clean the frame lower flange and the run-out area with the approved cleaning solvent. 5. CAUTION: DO NOT USE A METALLIC SCRAPER ON THE PROTECTIVE TREATMENT. DAMAGE TO THE TREATMENT CAUSES CORROSION. 6. Do a detailed visual inspection of the frame rib D5331113688429 at each station, with attention to the lower flange radius. 7. Do a detailed visual inspection of the lower intercostal D5331115152546 and of the fastener rows that attach it. 8. Examine the loading rail reaction bracket land for fretting or for movement of the protective treatment. 9. Record the station, the side and the distance from the nearest fastener for every indication. 10. Make sure that an indication longer than 12 mm, or one that crosses a fastener row, is reported to the engineering organisation before the aircraft is released. 11. Install the lining and the floor panels.
sections.close_out: Make sure that the work area is clean and that no tool or loose object is left in the compartment. Install the cargo floor panels and the lining panels. Do the cargo compartment lighting check. Record the inspection result in the aircraft technical record, including a nil return when nothing is found.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. On aircraft post the corrosion-resistant doubler standard the joint land inspection of this task is not required.

safety_precautions: Make sure that the aft cargo door is safe against inadvertent closing.
Put the warning notices in the flight compartment.
Make sure that the aircraft is on its wheels in the level attitude.
